dc_eval_cbrn.quote: On the two long-form virology tasks, Opus 4.8 achieved end-to-end scores of 0.77 and 0.89
dc_eval_cbrn.locator: 2.2.4 Biological risk results: CB-1 automated evaluations

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Claude Opus 4.8 scored 5.45 on AutoNudge, and 5.02 on plain.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: We assess that Claude Opus 4.8 does not cross the automated AI-R&D capability threshold.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D threshold determination, AECI score 155.5

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: The helpful-only version of Claude Opus 4.8 showed a notably higher success rate than even Claude Mythos Preview on both tasks
dc_eval_persuasion.note: influence-operation task completion rates 73.3% and 55.1% reported

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Under the realistic Extended Thinking conditions, Claude Opus 4.8’s stealth rate is just over 1% and roughly flat across reasoning-effort levels

framework_threshold.quote: Non-novel chemical and biological weapons (CB-1): We believe it is hard to be confident whether a model passes this threshold, but (as with previous recent models) our results are consistent with Opus 4.8 providing significant uplift
framework_threshold.note: RSP thresholds CB-1, CB-2, AI R&D placed for this model

ext_test_any.quote: we are grateful to a number of external testers for running assessments of the model and sharing their results with us.
ext_test_any.note: external testers named in later sections

ext_test_named_org.quote: We worked with Gray Swan, an external research partner, to host a one-week live bug bounty in which expert red teamers competed for a pool of prizes awarded for successful prompt injection attacks against a set of models including Claude Opus 4.8.
ext_test_named_org.note: also UK AISI (6.2.4), Andon Labs (6.2.5); no statement that testing was after release

ext_test_government.quote: we shared a pre-release snapshot of Claude Opus 4.8 with UK AISI for open-ended testing
ext_test_government.locator: 6.2.4 External testing from the UK AI Security Institute
ext_test_government.note: UK AISI tested an early checkpoint

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: we shared a pre-release snapshot of Claude Opus 4.8 with UK AISI for open-ended testing
ext_test_timing_stated.locator: 6.2.4 External testing from the UK AI Security Institute

safeguards_training.quote: After the pretraining process, Opus 4.8 underwent substantial post-training and fine-tuning, with the goal of making it an assistant whose behavior aligns with the values described in Claude’s constitution.
safeguards_training.note: constitutional training; harmlessness training also referenced in 5.1.3

safeguards_runtime.quote: For Claude Opus 4.8, these include our Constitutional Classifiers related to chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear (CBRN) weapon information

safeguards_access.quote: Cybersecurity practitioners who have appropriate dual use cases and who are experiencing blocks from these probes can apply for exemptions from these safeguards through our Cyber Verification Program.
safeguards_access.note: trusted-access exemption programme; also access controls for classifier guard exemptions (2.1.3.2)

safeguards_weights.quote: a variety of rapid response options for jailbreaks; and security controls to reduce risk of model weight theft
safeguards_weights.note: weight-theft controls applied to this model as part of CB-1 safeguards
